typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(isNull(MemberID), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(RemoveBlankRows,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(CodeType = 'NOP') ~> AddCodeType
AddCodeType derive(xMemberNum = MemberID,
		xCodeType = toString(CodeType)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(xMemberNum = xMemberNum) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER = xMemberNum,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE = xCodeType)) ~> PDSOBMEMEMBERCODESSTAGING
